component.name: Glance
component.summary: Lightweight real-time Linux process and application monitor

description.p: Glance is a high-performance desktop process monitor designed for Linux. Instead of exposing a raw, overwhelming process table, it groups related Linux processes under their parent applications using systemd cgroup scopes, Flatpak/Snap identifiers, and desktop entry metadata.

ul.li: Notion-style progressive disclosure toggles for application process trees
Accurate memory accounting (PSS) and machine-wide CPU deltas
Instant race-free process termination via pidfd with safety protection tiers
Adaptive refresh cadence pausing when window is hidden
Native GNOME/Ubuntu styling with dark and light theme integration
